description: Affine georeference of the ParkGO annex map ('Anlage zur ParkGO', page 3 of 2_08_Parkgebuehrenordnung_2025.pdf) in its north-up rendering raw_sources/bs_2_08_annex_north_up.png (1477 x 1155 px): EPSG:25832 metres -> image pixels, px = a E + b N + c, py = d E + e N + f.
fit: v1 curation of 2026-09-29 (scratch code, not committed in v1 because the fit produced no committed geometry): affine chamfer fit of the exterior rings of the committed bs_zone_ia and bs_zone_ib polygons north of N 5790560 (the lower edge of the city's overview map, where those polygons are closed artificially) to the thick zone lines of the annex (dark pixels with max RGB < 60, 3 x 3 opening, connected parts of at least 1500 px), Powell minimisation of the mean truncated distance with truncation 8, 4 and 2 px, started from the least-squares affine of the five BgA car-park dots (start_affine_px/py, check-point RMS 20.8 m). Parameters copied verbatim from that fit; re-running the scratch fit from the same start on 2026-09-30 reproduced them bit for bit (anisotropy 1.0956, shear angle 89.93 deg). The v1 digitising notes of bs_zone_ia/bs_zone_ib quote the same statistics.

use: Plausibility check and tariff-zone assignment of the rule-based cores of parking cost zones v2 (issue #436, spec amendment A2); not a geometry source: the annex could not be georeferenced to an RMS of 10 m or better.
